summary: Broadcasts two independent blocks of per-vehicle state from a large this-struct into process-wide telemetry globals. Each block is gated by its own bit-0 enable flag (this+0x1180 for block 0, this+0x157C for block 1): when enabled it calls D3DShaderConstantSetup, clamps eight float channels against global min/max thresholds (writing a zeroed value when a channel crosses a threshold) to sixteen output floats, dispatches sixteen byte flags through ConditionalFieldSetterWithState into global dwords, and — when the enable word's sign bit (bit 7) is set — writes equality-comparison booleans (this+0x1170/0x1174/0x1178/0x117C against reference globals), with bits 0x100/0x200/0x400 cascading to deeper tiers. Opens with sub_44F150(this+4, a2).
